mei: Onboarding OrbitonX-v2 convert. Quick repro: converted model drifts on >1024 tokens; short prompts look fine. Suspect rotary per-head + a small token-id remap.

mei: Convert command: `./tools/convert_checkpoint --in orbitonx_v2.ckpt --out rdl/orbitonx_v2.pt --src-vocab s_vocab.json --dst-vocab rdl_vocab.json`
Converter log: `mapped=50182 unmapped=20 warn: contiguous-shift applied to ids 198..423 (+1)`

tarek: contiguous-shift is our old fallback. That will change dst ids for a whole range and break kv-cache lookups. Can you run a quick hash-compare of kv-keys for a deterministic prompt?

mei: did that. first mismatch at token index 201 (vendor id 201 -> converted id 202). Short prompt 64-token cosine(logits)=0.996. Long prompt 2048 tokens: vendor vs converted top-1 match drops from 93% -> 76%.

julia: two fixes: 1) change remap strategy to nearest (no range shifts) and emit id_map.json, 2) import per-head rotary multipliers from src meta. Which to prioritize?

mei: did a quick local patch: remap->nearest + apply per-head rotary factors. Long prompt top-1 match improves to 89% on fp16.

eval-bot: Snapshot (short suite): vendor fp16 ppl=18.1, converted fp16 (old) ppl=20.3, converted fp16 (remap+perhead) ppl=18.6. INT4 baseline ppl=24.7, INT4 + bias-corr + perhead ppl=19.9.

ci-bot: CI: started job 10122 to run convert/quant unit tests and regen-evals.

tarek: ok plan: land remap-strategy=nearest by default + id_map json. Add loader assertion to fail if contiguous-shift present. Add small smoke test comparing first-64 logits against vendor.

mei: will open PRs and paste links here. Thanks all.
